_comment: Copy to config.json (or point the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable at another path). This file holds only database and skill_dir; other config such as LLM settings comes from environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > this file's database. Pick one of two forms: (A) fill in the individual fields below; (B) set a single complete connection string in database.dsn.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): delete the database block above and use a complete DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each with a SKILL.md). Priority: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or delete this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
